features: Premium Metal Finish with 1.83'' (4.64 cm) HD Display: Behold the boAt Storm Blaze smartwatch, blending classic metal-finish aesthetics with a modern 1.83" (4.64 cm) HD touchscreen display. Crafted with classic sophistication and new-age charm in mind, its crisp 240 × 284 resolution and up to 500 nits brightness ensure a clear, vibrant viewing experience in any lighting condition.

Functional Crown & Custom Menu: Easily scroll through your smartwatch's main menu using the rotating functional crown. You can swiftly switch main menu styles, such as List, Grid, Waterfall, Honeycomb List, and more, for fluid and dynamic UI transitions. What's more, enjoy deep personalization with 100+ watch faces and animation support to match your mood, style, and occasion.

Advanced BT Calling with Smart Notifications: Access the dialpad, save frequent contacts, and view call history directly from your smartwatch for an advanced Bluetooth calling experience. Plus, receive smart notifications for texts, calls, and app alerts right on your wrist, and send Quick Replies to keep important conversations at your fingertips.

IP68 Water Resistance: Engineered for your active life, Storm Blaze features robust IP68 water and dust resistance. It is dust-tight and completely blocks out dust, sand, and dirt. Plus, it is well-equipped to handle heavy perspiration during workouts, and can easily withstand rain, accidental spills, and use near sinks.

Battery Life Up to 7 Days with Power Saving Mode: Eliminating the need for daily charging, the Storm Blaze comes with an extended battery life of up to 7 days in single full charge. Moreover, it features a dedicated Power Saving Mode, that further stretches the battery life by optimizing the background processes while maintaining core tracking functionality.
